mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase significantly above 200k and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it indicates a strong labor market which can lead to wage inflation, and thus negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) above 1.5 million units signals strong demand in the housing market, which is a positive signal for the economy and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is declining, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.
